title: Nexusfinance
tagline: GOD OF DEFI - NEXUS FINANCE powered of avail nexus. PERPS, GAS, STAKE
description: NexusFinance is a revolutionary cross-chain DeFi platform that serves as the universal perpetual aggregator for the decentralized finance ecosystem. Built on the Avail Nexus SDK, it eliminates the fragmentation barriers that currently plague DeFi by providing unified access to perpetual trading, yield optimization, and gas management across multiple blockchains.
how_its_made:
Core Technology Stack
Frontend Foundation
React 18 with TypeScript for type-safe, modern component development
Vite as the build tool for lightning-fast development and optimized production builds
Tailwind CSS with custom animations and glassmorphism effects for the sleek UI
Lucide React for consistent, scalable iconography
Web3 Integration Layer
Wagmi v2 for React hooks-based Ethereum integration
Viem for low-level blockchain interactions and type safety
Ethers.js v6 for additional Web3 functionality and compatibility
Reown AppKit (formerly WalletConnect) for universal wallet connectivity
Cross-Chain Infrastructure
Avail Nexus SDK - The crown jewel of our architecture
@avail-project/nexus-widgets for React-specific Nexus components
Custom hooks and services built around Nexus SDK's bridgeAndExecute functionality
The Nexus SDK Integration - Our Secret Sauce
